parent: 黎明書局 / foreign canonical thinning
goal: 把外文資源從『來源文件』收縮成真正的 canonical Work；English translation、Greek/Latin original、不同 public-domain editions 都作 witness/edition/source relations，不重複計為多本書。

identityRules.work: 作者 + 作品身份/傳統標題 + 作品邊界；不以語言或檔案來源建立新 Work。
identityRules.witness: 同一作品的 Greek/Latin/English/other-language text witness。
identityRules.edition: 具體出版/翻譯/編輯版本；保留 translator/editor/year/publisher。
identityRules.translationProjection: 黎明書局即時繁中是 reading projection，不建立虛構 Chinese Edition。

canonicalWorks.title: On the Incarnation of the Word
canonicalWorks.dedupAction: merge English/Greek manifestations under one Work; verify exact Greek work identity before promotion

canonicalWorks.title: Against the Heathen
canonicalWorks.dedupAction: parts/books remain structural children, not separate Works unless bibliographic evidence requires otherwise

canonicalWorks.title: On the Holy Spirit
canonicalWorks.dedupAction: Books I-III grouped beneath one Work; English and Latin become witnesses/editions

canonicalWorks.title: On the Duties of the Clergy
canonicalWorks.dedupAction: Books I-III grouped beneath one Work

sourceAlignment.OpenChristianData: use as structured English reading witness and metadata seed when provenance is sufficient; do not let individual files/books inflate Work count.
sourceAlignment.PatristicTextArchive: preferred evidence source for open critical/digital editions when exact work coverage exists; per-file Creative Commons license must remain attached because PTA files may carry different CC licenses.
sourceAlignment.OpenGreekAndLatin: use Greek/Latin text as witness candidates only after work attribution and OCR/edition quality are verified; records explicitly marked [Sp.] or uncertain attribution must never silently merge into an authentic author Work.
sourceAlignment.PRDL: use title/volume index to resolve historical editions and cross-source bibliographic identity; linked-host rights remain authoritative.
sourceAlignment.CatholicCorpus: use identifiable patristic/theological manifestations as additional witnesses; Scripture rows remain excluded from Dawn translation product.

uncertainAttributionRule: Pseudo-, spurious, doubtful and anonymous works receive distinct attribution state and cannot be merged merely because a source filename contains Athanasius/Ambrose/etc.
readerEffect: Browse leaf shows one cover/title identity per canonical Work. After selection, the right reading leaf may choose the best readable witness automatically, while source/edition can be changed on demand. 中文翻譯 follows the selected authoritative witness without changing Work identity.
scaleEffect: This pass deliberately reduces visible collection count while increasing usable language depth: one Work may gain several original/translation witnesses. Capability grows while catalogue noise shrinks.
next: Apply the same clustering rules to Basil of Caesarea, Gregory of Nazianzus, Gregory of Nyssa, John Cassian, Jerome, Eusebius and other author clusters, then emit promotion-ready Work records only where identity + provenance + rights gates pass.
